flow: User rejects the Hero, picks technical or preference, then taps items. UI sends fix_requests [{code, instruction, note?}] with previous_output. Inferred critical fields on the Spec card can be edited directly; an edit marks the field confirmed (source user) and re-runs fix mode.

items.label: The object is cut off or incomplete
items.label_fa: شیء کامل نیست یا از کادر بیرون زده
items.instruction: Show the whole object inside the frame with a comfortable margin on every side; nothing cropped.

items.label: Background is not plain grey
items.label_fa: پس‌زمینه ساده و خاکستری نیست
items.instruction: Use a seamless, uniform neutral mid-grey background with no environment, floor line, gradient, other objects or color.

items.label: Harsh, colored or too dark lighting
items.label_fa: نور تند، رنگی یا خیلی تاریک است
items.instruction: Use soft, even, diffused studio light with neutral white balance; every part and detail must be clearly readable.

items.label: Hands, people or other objects appear
items.label_fa: دست، آدم یا شیء دیگری در تصویر است
items.instruction: Show the object alone: remove all hands, people, figures and every other object.

items.label: Parts are duplicated, melted or extra
items.label_fa: قطعات تکراری، ذوب‌شده یا اضافه دارد
items.instruction: Make every part single, distinct and fully formed, exactly the parts listed in the spec; remove duplicated, fused or extra parts.

items.label: Shape is distorted by the camera
items.label_fa: شکل شیء با زاویه دوربین کج و اغراق‌شده شده
items.instruction: Use a long-lens perspective from the hero three-quarter angle with no wide-angle distortion, so the true shape and proportions read correctly.

items.label: Proportions do not match the description
items.label_fa: تناسبات با توضیحات نمی‌خواند
items.instruction: Match the proportions in the spec exactly (height : width : depth) and keep the silhouette described.

items.label: Something I said must stay is missing or changed
items.label_fa: چیزی که گفته بودم حتماً بماند حذف یا عوض شده
items.instruction: Restore every must_keep item exactly as specified, in its stated face and position.

items.label: It does not look like my reference
items.label_fa: شبیه عکس رفرنس من نیست
items.instruction: Reproduce the object of the identity reference faithfully: same shape, proportions, parts and details, changing only what the change text says.

items.label: Text or symbols are garbled or mirrored
items.label_fa: نوشته یا نشانه‌ها خراب یا آینه‌ای است
items.instruction: Follow the text rule: allowed legible text exactly as quoted, left-to-right and not mirrored; all other writing as clean non-legible marks.

items.label: A detail is on the wrong side
items.label_fa: یک جزئیات در سمت اشتباه است
items.instruction: Place every asymmetric detail on the face and position stated in the DNA, translated to the viewer's left or right for this view.

items.label: Wrong state (open/closed, on/off)
items.label_fa: وضعیت اشتباه است (باز/بسته، روشن/خاموش)
items.instruction: Show the object in its default state exactly as defined in the DNA.

items.label: The style is not respected
items.label_fa: سبک پروژه رعایت نشده
items.instruction: Render the object only in the effective style: form language, material rendering, shading and line work must match it, with no mixing of styles.

items.label: It came out as several images or a collage
items.label_fa: چند تصویر یا کلاژ شده
items.instruction: Render ONE object in ONE continuous frame: no panels, grid, borders or multiple views.

items.label: Change the shape or silhouette
items.label_fa: فرم یا سیلوئت را عوض کن
items.instruction: Change the shape as stated in the note; update geometry and parts consistently.

items.label: Change the colors
items.label_fa: رنگ‌ها را عوض کن
items.instruction: Change the colors as stated in the note, keeping shape and materials.

items.label: Change materials or surface finish
items.label_fa: متریال یا پرداخت سطح را عوض کن
items.instruction: Change materials or finish as stated in the note, keeping the shape.

items.label: Too new or clean, make it older
items.label_fa: خیلی نو و تمیز است، کهنه‌ترش کن
items.instruction: Add believable age and wear (scratches, patina, softened edges, dirt in recesses) consistent with its materials and story, keeping the design.

items.label: Too worn, make it cleaner
items.label_fa: خیلی فرسوده است، تمیزترش کن
items.instruction: Reduce wear and damage, keeping the design, materials and era.

items.label: Make it more detailed or ornate
items.label_fa: جزئیات یا تزئین بیشتر
items.instruction: Add detail and ornament consistent with the era, world and style, without changing silhouette or must_keep items.

items.label: Make it simpler
items.label_fa: ساده‌ترش کن
items.instruction: Simplify ornament and secondary details, keeping silhouette, signature details and must_keep items.

items.label: Doesn't fit the era, world or genre
items.label_fa: با دوره، دنیا یا ژانر نمی‌خواند
items.instruction: Redesign the design vocabulary (technology level, ornament, construction, wear) to fit the project's era, world and genre, keeping must_keep items.

items.label: Change size or scale
items.label_fa: اندازه یا مقیاس را عوض کن
items.instruction: Change the scale and proportions as stated in the note; update dna.scale.

items.label: Change one specific detail
items.label_fa: یک جزئیات مشخص را عوض کن
items.instruction: Change the detail named in the note, keeping everything else identical.

items.label: Change the style (Pro only)
items.label_fa: سبک را عوض کن (فقط Pro)
items.instruction: Re-render in the style sent as style_override, keeping the design identical.

items.label: Something else (write it)
items.label_fa: مورد دیگر (بنویس)
items.instruction: Apply the user's note.

items.label: Try again (new variation)
items.label_fa: دوباره بساز (نسخه جدید)
